spec.data_source: Native IAM GetAccountAuthorizationDetails GroupDetail inline policies and account-wide UserDetail GroupList inventory.
spec.predicate: At least one current IAM user declares membership in the exact group with inline policies. A current group has inline policies but a complete, valid account-wide IAM user inventory contains no member of that group.
spec.title: Group inline policies have member identities
spec.description: Reviews inline policies embedded in current IAM groups for declared user consumers. A group with inline policies fails only when a complete account-wide GetAccountAuthorizationDetails user inventory contains no member of that group. The current group ARN, stable identity, native source, complete policy documents and membership projection are checked. A known current member is positive structural evidence even when unrelated user enumeration is partial. This is not authentication or action-use history, and no unused-day count is inferred.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm group ownership and remove obsolete embedded policies after reviewing intended consumers.

evaluated: native group name, ARN, stable GroupId and matching account-wide projection
inline policy names and complete policy documents with action/resource clauses
native IAM user IDs, ARNs and complete GroupList values
complete user enumeration before absence; independent positive membership survives partial reads
description.pass_when: At least one current IAM user declares membership in the exact group with inline policies.
description.fail_when: A current group has inline policies but a complete, valid account-wide IAM user inventory contains no member of that group.
description.not_applicable_when: The current native group has no inline policy; missing or denied policy/membership evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.
